value: the inference is still not read-by-read - `the smallest unit of data from which ASVs can be inferred is a sample`, because a sequence is distinguished from an error partly by being seen more than once
quote: As a result, ASV inference cannot be performed independently on each read—the smallest unit of data from which ASVs can be inferred is a sample.

value: Without consistent labels a result cannot be tested. `The absence of consistent labels makes replicating or falsifying previous results problematic, even impossible` - an association with a de novo OTU can only be retested by first coarsening it to taxonomy or to a diversity metric
quote: The absence of consistent labels makes replicating or falsifying previous results problematic, even impossible. Consider a significant association reported between a particular de novo OTU and a condition of interest. This association cannot be tested in a new data set, because that de novo OTU only exists within the data set in which it was defined. Therefore, results from the analysis of de novo OTUs can only be tested indirectly, by mapping de novo OTUs onto consistent labels such as taxonomy or reducing community composition to summary measures such as a diversity metric, and then testing the results at that coarser level.
